title: 6.13 Three Trips Around Town
unit_outcome: Name places and transport, explain a current destination, complete a trip, follow directions, ask for help, choose a service and check its times.
goal: Retrieve Unit 6 through three clearly separated practical stories, using fresh scenes and no new language.
grammar_function: Three fresh transfer trips: family boat to mall/supermarket and taxi to hotel; asking different helpers, taking the blue bus and following safe walking directions to the museum; checking train times, buying and receiving a ticket, reaching the airport and boarding an airplane.
prerequisite: Units 1–5 and the earlier Unit 6 lessons in the displayed course sequence.
speaking_outcome: Retrieve Unit 6 through three clearly separated practical stories, using fresh scenes and no new language.
